title: Traditional German Schnitzel
description: A classic German dish made with breaded and fried pork cutlets. This recipe is easy to make and always a crowd pleaser.
instructions: Season the pork cutlets with salt, black pepper, and meditteranean seasoning.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, eggs, and stir.
Dip each pork cutlet into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add 1/4 cup of fry.
Add the breaded pork cutlets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer the cooked pork cutlets to a plate and serve with lemon wedges and tomato slices.
Optional: Serve with a side of wholesome mashed potatoes or meditteranean salad.
